rca_of_the_issue: Auto-away WhatsApp Business replies were treated as invalid customer input, which the menu handler responded to by re-emitting the menu. That formed a self-sustaining loop (bot menu -> auto-reply -> bot menu). The 2026-08-06 fix (advance_flow menu invalid branch, lines ~1160-1198 dynamic and ~1213-1256 static) drops the re-emit while keeping the reprompt counter + 3-strike bot_paused safeguard. Tests confirm: sent list is empty on invalid reply, counter increments, bot pauses after 3, valid replies unaffected, and capture_format re-prompt path is intact.
